en.name: Soy crumbles and soy hot dogs, frozen
en.summary: Frozen soy crumbles and soy hot dogs keep 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen and cook as directed. Once cooked, they keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. Being meat-free changes nothing about the handling: these are moist, low-acid, high-protein foods, usually with added oil, and they support bacterial growth just as readily as the meat versions do. Anything left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Soy hot dogs in particular are often ready-to-eat, so there is no cooking step left to correct mishandling.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once cooked, covered — that is what the figure describes. An opened pack of thawed crumbles should be used within a day or two and kept sealed, because the surface dries and picks up fridge odours quickly. Reheat right through to steaming hot rather than to lukewarm, and reheat only the portion you will eat.
en.freezer: 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — short, and for the same reason as the meat versions: the added vegetable oil is dispersed throughout the product and oxidises steadily even at freezer temperature, giving an over-kept pack a stale, cardboardy, painty taste. That window is about quality, not safety: kept continuously at −18 °C these stay safe indefinitely. Press the air out of an opened bag and reseal it tightly each time.
en.thawing: Cook crumbles straight from frozen wherever the pack allows it — they break apart easily and heat through quickly. Otherwise thaw in the fridge, never on the counter. Anything thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: A stale, cardboardy or painty smell from the oil — the usual failure.
Dry, pale, crumbly patches — freezer burn.
A slimy or sticky surface on thawed hot dogs, which means they go out.
A solid welded block or heavy ice in the bag, meaning it part-thawed and refroze.
tips: Cook crumbles from frozen; they need no thawing at all.
Reseal the bag tightly with the air pressed out — the oil is what ages.
Label the bag with the date; one to two months goes quickly.
Treat soy hot dogs like any ready-to-eat product: keep them cold and do not leave them out.

faq.q: How long do frozen soy crumbles last?
faq.a: 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. They stay safe longer if they never thaw, but the oil in them goes stale.

faq.q: Do meat-free products need the same care as meat?
faq.a: Yes. They are moist, low-acid and high in protein, so they sit in the danger zone exactly the same way. Many are also ready-to-eat, which makes careful handling more important, not less.

faq.q: Can you cook soy crumbles from frozen?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the easiest way — they break apart and heat through in a few minutes straight from the bag.

zh.name: 冷凍素絞肉與素熱狗
zh.summary: 冷凍素絞肉與素熱狗在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 1～2 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示烹調。煮熟之後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。「不是肉」並不會改變任何處理方式：它們同樣是含水量高、低酸、高蛋白的食物，而且通常加了油脂，細菌長起來和葷的版本一樣順利。任何擺在外面的都在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。素熱狗尤其常常是即食產品，後面沒有加熱步驟可以幫你補救。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天——這個數字描述的正是這個狀態。已經解凍、拆封的素絞肉請在一兩天內用掉並密封好，因為表面很快會變乾、又很會吸冰箱的味道。回熱要熱到中心冒熱氣，不要只是溫溫的，而且吃多少熱多少。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月品質最好——很短，理由和葷的版本一樣：添加的植物油分散在整個產品裡，即使在冷凍溫度下也持續氧化，讓放過頭的那包吃起來走味、有紙板味甚至油漆味。這是品質期限不是安全期限：全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的。拆封後每次都要壓出空氣、確實封緊。
zh.thawing: 包裝允許的話，素絞肉直接從冷凍下鍋最好——它很容易散開，也熱得很快。否則請放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 油脂發出走味、紙板味或油漆味——最常見的結局。
出現乾燥、發白、粉碎的斑塊——那是凍燒。
解凍後的素熱狗表面黏滑或黏手，那就該丟。
整包凍成硬塊或結了厚冰，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
tips: 素絞肉從冷凍直接煮，完全不必解凍。
每次都壓出空氣、把袋子封緊——會老化的是油脂。
袋上標日期；一到兩個月過得很快。
素熱狗請比照即食品處理：保持低溫，不要擺在外面。

faq.q: 冷凍素絞肉可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但裡面的油脂會走味。

faq.q: 素的產品需要和肉一樣小心嗎？
faq.a: 需要。它們同樣含水高、低酸又高蛋白，在危險溫度帶裡的行為完全一樣；而且很多是即食品，反而更該小心。

faq.q: 素絞肉可以從冷凍直接煮嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且這是最省事的做法——直接下鍋幾分鐘就散開熱透了。
